subject: Request: GCP Private Offer — tailored commission + netting exceptions
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, sean_gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>, irene_choi <irene@redwood.ai>, evelyn_hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>
Cc: Claire Duval <claire@finitylabs.com>, Aaron Schmidt <aaron.schmidt@finitylabs.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T08:14:00-08:00
Subject: Request: GCP Private Offer — tailored commission + netting exceptions

Team — looping you in on Finity Labs (seed-stage analytics SaaS). They are asking for a private offer via GCP Marketplace. Key ask summarized below; details attached (Finity_PrivOffer_Details.pdf + Financial_Model_Finity.xlsx).

Why this matters: Finity is projecting $720k ARR in year one (customer-provided forecast) and is a strategic use-case for our low-latency private deployments. They will reference Redwood in a GCP partner case study if we get favorable commercial terms.

Ask (one-off exceptions to standard marketplace template):
- Rev-share carve: 30% revenue share to Finity for the first 12 months (standard is 20%).
- Upfront credit: $100k against first invoices to help migration costs (to be netted against usage).
- Invoice terms: Net 90 (Finity request) instead of our standard Net 45.
- Netting clause: allow Finity to net GCP promotional credits against our invoices for first 6 months (nonstandard).

Why they asked: procurement tight on cash + partner co-marketing requirements. Impact: projected decrease in gross margin in year 1; Finance model attached shows payback if adoption hits their forecast.

Decision requested: Executive approval for these deviations (rev-share > +10% from standard / net90) — I need a yes/no and any conditions by EOD today so Deal Desk can push the private offer public on GCP by Friday.

Attachments: Finity_PrivOffer_Details.pdf / Financial_Model_Finity.xlsx / GCP_Listing_Draft.docx

Thanks,
Mina
Mina Haddad
Senior Account Executive, Marketplace
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, sean_gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>, irene_choi <irene@redwood.ai>, evelyn_hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>
Cc: Claire Duval <claire@finitylabs.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T09:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: GCP Private Offer — tailored commission + netting exceptions

Mina — thanks for the summary and the model. A couple quick asks from deal-desk side before an exec decision: 

1) Please surface the 12-month CET (customer expected term) ARR waterfall in the attached Financial_Model_Finity.xlsx — I need to see best/likely/worst.
2) What is the projected net revenue to Redwood in year 1 under the requested 30% rev-share and $100k credit? (line item).
3) Any SLA or custom support commitments tied to the co-marketing ask? If yes, we should quantify estimated incremental SRE hours / cost.
4) Legal: confirm whether the proposed netting language creates exposure to third-party GCP credits that we cannot recover.

I will hold on a formal recommend until we get those clarifications — if the numbers show payback within 9 months (base case) I will lean toward approval with caps.

-karthik
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, sean_gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>
Cc: irene_choi <irene@redwood.ai>, Claire Duval <claire@finitylabs.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T10:21:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: GCP Private Offer — tailored commission + netting exceptions

Mina / team — I ran a quick sensitivity on the attached model. My commercial recommendation to mitigate downside risk: 

- Phase the rev-share: 30% for the first 90 days from activation, step down to 20% thereafter for the remainder of year 1. This protects short-term GTM needs but limits long-run erosion.
- Cap total rev-share paid to Finity at $200k for the first 12 months (regardless of usage).
- Make the upfront credit refundable / contingent on minimum usage thresholds (e.g., $50k/month by month 3) or clawback on early termination.
- Reject Net 90. If Finance / Legal insists, we can allow Net 60 with milestone-based payment triggers.

If Legal can redline the netting language to ensure credits cannot be double-counted against our settlement with GCP, I think this is approvable by execs.

Marissa
VP, Commercial Strategy
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, sean_gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>
Cc: Claire Duval <claire@finitylabs.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T11:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: GCP Private Offer — tailored commission + netting exceptions

Team — legal review (high level): 

- The current netting clause as proposed exposes Redwood to third-party credit offsets we cannot audit. We need a carve that limits netting to GCP Marketplace credits that are issued directly to Finity by GCP AND are documented in the customer's marketplace billing file. No unilateral offsets.
- Net 90 is a contract risk for us. Recommend Net 45; if we must move to Net 60, add a secured credit note / escrow for the $100k credit.
- Termination: remove open-ended unilateral termination rights tied to co-marketing. If we provide co-marketing commitments, include 30-day cure and pro-rata repayment for credits if customer terminates early.
- IP / case study clause: Legal should approve any quote; require marketing sign-off.

I will prepare a redline of GCP_Listing_Draft.docx and return by 5pm.

—Irene
Head of Legal Operations
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, irene_choi <irene@redwood.ai>
Cc: Claire Duval <claire@finitylabs.com>, Aaron Schmidt <aaron.schmidt@finitylabs.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T13:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: GCP Private Offer — tailored commission + netting exceptions

Evelyn — compiling recommended final offer per above and attaching updated financials (Financial_Model_Finity.xlsx). Short summary for approval: 

- Offer: Private GCP listing with phased rev-share — 30% for first 90 days, 20% thereafter through month 12. Cap rev-share payments to $200k first 12 months.
- Credit: $100k upfront credit, escrowed and subject to clawback if usage < $150k in first 3 months.
- Invoicing: Net 45 (Legal prefer), but Finance says Net 60 is possible with credit escrow.
- Netting: only allow documented GCP Marketplace promotional credits to offset Redwood invoices; finance to validate the file feed.

Recommendation: Approve the one-off commercial exceptions conditioned on Legal redlines and Finance escrow for credit. Please advise if you want a lower cap ($150k) or require additional SRE support commitments before we sign.

–Sean
Senior Deal Desk Operations
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, irene_choi <irene@redwood.ai>
Cc: Claire Duval <claire@finitylabs.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T15:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: GCP Private Offer — tailored commission + netting exceptions

Approved (conditional). Thanks for the clear summary. Conditions to proceed: 

1) Final rev-share schedule: 30% first 90 days, 20% thereafter through month 12.
2) Cap rev-share payments at $200,000 for the first 12 months.
3) Upfront credit $100k requires escrow / clawback tied to the usage thresholds Sean outlined.
4) Invoicing: Net 45. Finance may set Net 60 operationally if escrow is in place, but contract will read Net 45.
5) Legal to finalize redlines that limit netting to documented marketplace credits and include a 30-day cure for termination.

Once Legal uploads the redline and Finance confirms escrow mechanics, Mina — please instruct Deal Desk to publish the private offer and notify Finity. Great job balancing upside vs. risk.

—Evelyn
VP, Head of Marketplace Sales
